title: Prospective zero-fit factorial audit of prescribed-head Reference boundary discretization
scientific_question: Which discrete ingredient controls the persistent R512-R1024 prescribed-head spatial gap under the C5I B14 T16 workload: half-cell boundary distance semantics, last-cell-center conductivity localization, or their interaction?

current_reference_bottom_semantics: With frozen swkimpl=0 the bottom face conductivity is initialized as kmean(NN+1)=k(NN), i.e. the last cell-center conductivity.

frozen_workload.lower_boundary: exact C5I dynamic prescribed-head RISE/FALL with mode-2 HOLD

G1K0.label: DISTANCE_DOUBLE_CONTROL
G1K0.interpretation: Semantic sensitivity control for whether hbot behaves as a face value versus a ghost-node-center value. Not proposed as a correct discretization.

G0K1.label: CENTER_BOUNDARY_ARITHMETIC_K
G0K1.interpretation: Extends frozen swkmean=1 arithmetic face averaging to the Dirichlet boundary without fitted parameters.

G1K1.label: COMBINED_DISTANCE_AND_K_CONTROL
G1K1.interpretation: Factorial interaction cell only; not a candidate production formulation.

implementation_contract: Counterfactuals are materialized from frozen Reference headcalc only in workflow scratch; repository production Reference source remains byte-unchanged.
Geometry toggle changes only explicit-geometry grid_disnod(NN+1) from 0.5*dz to dz.
Conductivity toggle changes only swbotb=5 bottom-face conductivity for provider-based explicit Reference runs after time-level-t conductivity initialization.
K_at_prescribed_boundary_head is evaluated with the same constitutive provider and prescribed hbot; no fitted coefficient is introduced.
With swkmean=1 the K1 face value is the arithmetic mean 0.5*(K_cell+K_boundary).
Mode-2 HOLD and seed physics remain unchanged.
All scientific comparisons are aggregated to the original 0.0008-day C5I output window.

primary: R512-R1024 bottom-flux gap RMSE, signed mean and max absolute error for each factorial cell
history-specific and phase-specific R512-R1024 gap diagnostics
RMSE norm of each contrast relative to baseline spatial-gap RMSE
least-squares projection of each contrast onto the baseline spatial-gap vector
spatial-gap RMSE ratio of each counterfactual to G0K0
controls: exact C5I G0K0 result hash and baseline metric reproduction
O0/O2 byte identity for each newly executed counterfactual geometry
HOLD response remains unchanged or is reported explicitly if the counterfactual unexpectedly affects it

adjudication_rules.descriptor_notes: Larger/comparable are descriptive pairwise comparisons of continuous RMSE norms; no hydrological acceptance threshold follows from them.

stop_rules: Do not run T32 or R2048 in C5J.
Do not modify production Reference Richards.
Do not fit any boundary parameter or select a coefficient using C5I/C5J residuals.
Do not alter LARE or rerun LARE.
If sensitivity isolates a promising discrete ingredient, close C5J with a theory-derived follow-up requirement rather than silently admitting the counterfactual.
If interaction dominates or results are structurally mixed, stop at mechanism characterization and require a new scientific formulation choice.

implementation_binding.allowed_new_code: workflow scratch patching of frozen Reference boundary semantics plus prebound factorial analysis
implementation_binding.prohibited_new_code: production Reference edits, fitted coefficients, response-driven variant changes, LARE changes, T32/R2048
